help.title: TWSNMP NEO Help Center
help.subtitle: Operation Guides, Documentation & Support
help.catGreeting: Welcome to TWSNMP NEO meow! Check here if you need any help or guidance🐾

map.title: Map (Topology Management)
map.summary: The main visual interface for placing, connecting, and monitoring network nodes.
tips: Right-click anywhere on the blank canvas to add nodes, networks, or draw items
Hold Shift and click nodes or ports to create and connect lines
Right-click nodes or SW-HUBs to run Ping, MIB Browser, 3D Panel, or edit properties
Use mouse wheel to zoom in/out, and drag to pan across the topology map

location.title: Location Map (GIS)
location.summary: Geographic node placement and status monitoring on OpenStreetMap.
tips: Select a node from the top dropdown and click on the map to place it
Click 'Lock Position' on the top-right to prevent accidental node dragging
Click any node marker on the map to view status and access quick actions

list.title: List (Resource Inventory)
list.summary: Unified inventory tables for Nodes, Pollings, Networks, Lines, and Draw Items.
tips: Switch resource types using the left sidebar menu (Nodes, Pollings, Networks, etc.)
Click any column header to sort in ascending or descending order
Use keyword search and filters to quickly find specific devices or metrics
Click 'Add from Template' to auto-generate standard monitoring configurations

reports.title: Reports (Analytics & Telemetry)
reports.summary: Aggregated analytics for LAN devices, IPAM, Flows, SLA, IoT sensors, and AI anomalies.
tips: Select the analysis category from the left sidebar (IPAM, Flow, Sensor, etc.)
Inspect IP address utilization heatmaps and NetFlow/sFlow traffic metrics
Interact with time-series charts for environmental sensors and smart plugs
Export aggregated reports directly via the CSV export button

pki.title: PKI (Private Certificate Authority)
pki.summary: Built-in Private CA for TLS certificate issuance, SCEP server, and lifecycle management.
tips: Manage Root/Intermediate CAs and issue new server/client TLS certificates
Review SCEP auto-enrollment endpoints and active issuance status for network devices
Track expiration dates and revocation status (CRL/OCSP) for all issued certificates

logs.title: Logs (Real-time & Historical Query)
logs.summary: High-performance log viewer for EventLog, Syslog, SNMP TRAP, NetFlow, sFlow, and ARP Watch.
tips: Switch log categories using the top tabs (EventLog, Syslog, TRAP, etc.)
Utilize regex search, severity filters, and time range pickers for fast investigation
Stored with Apache Parquet for lightning-fast querying across high log volumes
Click 'AI Log Diagnosis' to analyze error root causes and recommended actions

otel.title: OpenTelemetry (Telemetry Viewer)
otel.summary: Visualizer for OpenTelemetry metrics, distributed traces, and log streams.
tips: Switch between Metrics, Traces, and Logs from the left sidebar
Analyze inter-service call relationships using the interactive DAG topology map
Click traces to drill down into span hierarchy and latency bottlenecks

mqtt.title: MQTT (Topic Monitor)
mqtt.summary: Real-time MQTT topic subscription, payload inspection, and broker stats.
tips: View message throughput, latest payload, and topic health status in real time
Pretty-print JSON payloads to quickly inspect incoming telemetry data
Auto-generate polling instances directly from topic monitoring

system.title: System (Server Status & Resources)
system.summary: Host resource telemetry (CPU, Memory, Disk, Goroutines) and internal daemon metrics.
tips: Monitor real-time system performance telemetry and time-series resource charts
Inspect background daemon health and received packet/message counters
Check binary build version, Git commit hash, and uptime
